declarations.description: Light-DOM controls for filtering direct ol/ul li children and dl div children.
declarations.name: ListFilterElement

members.name: htmlFor
members.description: Associated list ID reference; empty when absent.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Validate configuration, refresh cached list text and category options, and apply filters. Returns false on reported errors.

members.name: reset
members.description: Clear filters without resetting the enclosing form. Returns false when controls are not ready.

events.name: list-filter:change
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Detail: reason (init, refresh, search, category, reset), search, category, shown, total. Counts exclude authored hidden items. Reset includes synchronization after an uncanceled native reset of a control's owning form, using the browser-restored default values.

events.name: list-filter:error
events.description: Bubbles and is composed. Detail: code and message. Also logs to console.error and restores component-owned list visibility.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Required list ID reference in the same tree.

attributes.name: search
attributes.description: Presence enables search. Only the empty attribute value is supported.

attributes.name: categories-map
attributes.description: JSON object mapping raw category values to string option labels; unmapped values use raw labels.

attributes.name: output-label
attributes.description: Base count template; built-in singular is {count} item when no base override is supplied.

attributes.name: output-label-zero
attributes.description: zero plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: output-label-one
attributes.description: one plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: output-label-two
attributes.description: two plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: output-label-few
attributes.description: few plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: output-label-many
attributes.description: many plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: output-label-other
attributes.description: other plural template containing {count}; falls back to output-label.

attributes.name: announce
attributes.description: polite or off. Uses a separate status region and delays typing announcements by 300ms.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: Native inherited language for Intl.PluralRules; refresh after ancestor language changes.

cssProperties.name: --list-filter-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap between generated flex control blocks.

declarations.name: defineListFilter
declarations.description: Registers the component when a browser registry is available. Called automatically when this module is imported.
